subject: alt-c-pg
title: (R)ALT.C.PROG.------TRS.
description: Diagram in PCC-27. (R)ALT-C-PG — the reality of alternative composite progressionalism — is crossed with TRS (transition). The diagram poses what *real* alternative composite progressionalism (not just the concept) requires when crossed with transition. Besides the main line to TRS (the crossing), two lines leave the subject: one to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), and one to (R)INT (the reality of intention). SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) joins the (R)INT line by a *dashed* line, which in Braxton's legend amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to. (R)INT → COS-AGN (cosmic assignment), which branches to EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) and to MT-INFO (multi-information) → (R)MTA-IMP (the reality of meta-implications) → RT-IMP (reality implications).
